source_note: Chinese hot-topic candidates are collected from public trend pages; English wording is matched to supplied official English headlines when possible, otherwise suggested neutrally.

topics.chinese_topic: 习近平主席的“比什凯克时间”
topics.why_hot: The top Baidu real-time entry, driven by official coverage of President Xi Jinping’s visit to Bishkek.
topics.share_angle: Briefly explain who is involved and why Chinese official media frame the visit as a diplomatic highlight; avoid adding operational details not in state reports.

topics.chinese_topic: 广州取消校服统一订购
topics.official_english: Guangzhou ends unified ordering of school uniforms
topics.why_hot: School uniforms affect students, parents and school budgets; the policy news immediately resonates across households.
topics.share_angle: Let viewers compare China’s school uniform system with their own; clarify what changes for parents and what is expected to stay the same.

topics.chinese_topic: 世界已进入极端天气危险区
topics.official_english: World has entered an extreme-weather danger zone
topics.why_hot: Climate-related warnings are a global concern, and the words “danger zone” make the risk vivid and shareable.
topics.share_angle: Turn the dramatic phrase into a clear explainer on how extreme-weather risks are being measured and what regions are watching closely.

topics.chinese_topic: 手机集体涨价 吓跑了买手机的人
topics.official_english: Smartphone prices rise collectively, scaring off buyers
topics.why_hot: Consumers feel the impact of phone price hikes at a time when handsets are among the biggest personal tech purchases.
topics.share_angle: Look at market reports and consumer comments to show why price sensitivity is rising and what brands may do next.

topics.official_english: Flu vaccine market sees a major shift
topics.why_hot: Vaccine supply, pricing and promotion are closely watched public-health issues, so reports of a changed market quickly stir discussion.
topics.share_angle: Use public government and company disclosures to unpack what “market reshuffle” means for ordinary people, while separating business news from medical guidance.

topics.why_hot: Earthquakes trigger immediate safety concerns; search interest spikes as people look for the latest official reports.
topics.share_angle: Lead with confirmed official information—location, time and impact if available—then note what remains unknown.

topics.chinese_topic: 中国房子迎来真正的分水岭
topics.official_english: China’s housing market reaches a real turning point
topics.why_hot: Home ownership and property prices remain major anxieties for Chinese families, so any “turning point” language gets wide attention.
topics.share_angle: Distinguish cyclical price moves from a structural turning point; use policy and demographic trends without predicting market direction.

topics.chinese_topic: 鸡蛋快跟猪肉一个价了
topics.official_english: Egg prices are approaching pork prices
topics.why_hot: The egg-versus-pork price comparison makes inflation easy to understand and reflects everyday cost-of-living pressures.
topics.share_angle: Give a quick explainer on food price reporting and why the comparison to pork is a striking signal for consumers.
